subject.title: fix(qa-lab): preserve emoji in Matrix timeout diagnostics

question: Should `truncateUtf16Safe` become part of a supported focused plugin SDK subpath for QA Lab, or should this truncation remain QA Lab-owned without expanding the public SDK?
rationale: The current import is not exported, while using the deprecated broad text barrel or adding a new public SDK subpath each carries an ownership and compatibility tradeoff that repository policy reserves for maintainers.

options.title: Publish the focused SDK subpath
options.body: Add the package export and required SDK surface coverage for `text-utility-runtime`, then retain the shared helper import.

options.title: Keep truncation QA-local
options.body: Implement or expose the behavior within QA Lab so this internal diagnostic does not expand the public plugin SDK.

options.title: Use the broad text barrel
options.body: Import from the currently exported but deprecated `text-runtime` barrel as a narrowly accepted exception.

recommendation.title: Publish the focused SDK subpath
recommendation.body: Add the package export and required SDK surface coverage for `text-utility-runtime`, then retain the shared helper import.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly routed into the discussion after the existing SDK-boundary finding and are the strongest available decision candidate.
